notes.title: New Version Lauched
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We have listen to your suggestions and we are glad to announce the following improvements:

 [list]
    [*]Fast forward button, now you can run your experiments twice the speed!
    [*]Better zoom, increased zoom out lets you always see the hole experiment
    [*]Better graphics, 4k graphics and better post processing.
[/list]

notes.title: Houston, we have a problem.
notes.content:
This is so embarrassing, the tutorial on level 15 broke again! ːsteamsadː

We have launched a patch that removed the tutorial, letting the players progress to level 15 and forward and allowing our developers to investigate the problem with a bit more calm.

If anyone finds moving the cannon difficult because of the lack of tutorial please let us know and we will gladly give you some pointers.

Regards,
Bellosoft

notes.title: New update released to fix issues on level 15.
notes.content:
We  have just released a patch to fix an issue on level 15. The cannon tutorial was not working properlly, making it impossible for the player to progress.

Please grab the latest update, if this is still a problem after the update, or if you encouter any other issues, please let us know and we will fix it ASAP.

Thanks "Singularity Axiom╘[◉_◉]╛" for reporting the issue.

notes.title: Achievements issue has been fixed
notes.content:
It was reported that the achievements were not working for some users. We discovered the issue was due to a problem on the Steam library for 64bits machines.

We have rolled out an update, so please get the latest  version if if you are having any problems.

Thanks

notes.title: We are launching very soon!
notes.content:

Thanks for your patience and support!
